messages.subject: For Ken Seitz | Government affairs, mining and global stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Nutrien Government & Industry Affairs Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ken Seitz, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Nutrien's global position across potash, crop inputs and agricultural supply chains depends on sustained alignment with governments, regulators, communities and operating teams. My current role is built around that same requirement: turning external expectations into disciplined internal execution inside a major resource operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams, while maintaining senior institutional relationships. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating records.

I would value a senior discussion about where this experience might support Nutrien's government affairs, sustainability, mining, stakeholder or international country priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Nutrien.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
